content:
# Smart Pointers (C++11 and later)

Smart pointers manage the lifecycle of objects they point to, preventing memory leaks.
- `std::unique_ptr`: Sole ownership.
- `std::shared_ptr`: Shared ownership (reference counted).
- `std::weak_ptr`: Non-owning reference to an object managed by `shared_ptr`.
